contract.null_means: not provable from persisted artifacts (reason given); never silently 0
contract.historical_separate: historical/backfill/descriptive outcomes live under 'historical' and never feed forward layers
contract.maturity_rule: proven requires forward matured AND benchmark_evaluated AND validated_learning_applied > 0; outcomes or readers alone are not learning
contract.engines: five engines (market, fundamental, event, options, decision) + external_research reported separately
contract.privacy: decision/private options: presence-only flags from the sanitized server status; exact counts stay private
